title: Live box queue rejects its documented boolean host-CPU fallback
body: The first full VIXEN build through the required live queue failed before compilation in box-queue-core with unexpected argument 'true' while parsing --describe true. The documented recovery was to set UT_QUEUE_HOST_CPU_WSL=0 on the queued command; the same full build then completed. The queue wrapper should accept the documented fallback contract or detect and report the incompatible parser before admitting the job. Failed command: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-textshape1 --resource build --label cx-textshape1:build-full-gpu-scope -- bash -lc '... cmake --build build/wsl-debug'. Workaround: UT_QUEUE_HOST_CPU_WSL=0 on the same queued invocation.

title: Queued full VIXEN build resumes can terminate without a diagnostic
body: After the queue parser workaround, two resumed full VIXEN builds were externally terminated while ninja was still progressing, each ending only with a shell termination message and no compiler or target diagnostic: labels cx-textshape1:build-full-gpu-scope-retry, cx-textshape1:build-full-gpu-scope-retry2, and cx-textshape1:build-full-gpu-scope-resume. Re-running the same queued build with UT_QUEUE_HOST_CPU_WSL=0 eventually completed. The build/queue integration should preserve resumable progress and expose the termination cause instead of requiring blind manual resumes.
